description: Unit test class for PoliciesModelFactory, testing resource key creation, equality, and validation in the context of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package.

classes.name: PoliciesModelFactoryTest

methods.name: resourceKeysFromDifferentInstantiationsAreEqual
